title: Multilingual Knowledge Graph Completion from Pretrained Language Models with Knowledge Constraints

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Multilingual Knowledge Graph Completion (mKGC) performance (using Hits@1, Hits@3, and Hits@10 metrics) and cross-lingual entity alignment across seven different languages (German, Finnish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Turkish) to measure the model's ability to overcome English-centric bias and improve representations for low-resource languages compared to baseline models.
